text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've come to a shrine with Fine Motion, who's been feeling under the weather recently.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm… A Japanese power spot! I can't help getting my hopes up about this!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: After all, unusual events are known to occur at shrines, aren't they? We might catch sight of some fairies or messengers from the gods…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course! Even back in Ireland, people would spot fairies and things at old churches and the like… I've always wanted to see that sort of thing with my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, sometimes the people who witness those phenomena receive blessings! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Those spirits might even make me fighting fit again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle… Rustle…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It came from over there! Let's investigate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Scrambling after Fine Motion, I run towards the eerie sound…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crrrrk… Crrrrk… Ngh! Hrrrrgh! Creak!
Hnrghhh! PRINCESS PUUULLL!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew… Oh, hello, you two!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kawakami! Um, isn't that the rope… usually wrapped around sacred trees?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's right! It looked like it was getting a little slack, so the chief priest asked me to tighten it up!
choice_data_list: I never would've guessed that sound was you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What a surprise! ♪ So the fairy turned out to be Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But you know, that looks very invigorating! Could I help you out?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Of course! Right, then, let's get this rope nice and tight!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami and Fine
text_block_list.text: One, two… PUUULLL!

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text: Goodness! Thank you, all three of you. Ho ho ho, I expect the gods themselves are just as pleased as I am.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Gracious, the gods themselves? It's an honor to have been of assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps due to divine providence, Fine Motion's condition begins to noticeably improve in the days after!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I accompany Fine Motion as she hurries towards the eerie sound, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crrrrrk… Snap! Shnnnng…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Oh? The sound stopped. I wonder what happened…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I have a bad feeling about this.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sometimes the mischief fairies and yokai like to engage in goes beyond simple pranks.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We can't have anything happening to you, can we, Trainer? Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We make our way carefully back towards the shrine, and Fine Motion's condition doesn't improve at all…
